source: Yu & LaValle, Tracking Hidden Agents Through Shadow Information Spaces, ICRA 2008, Sec. IV Fig. 4 (shadow-sequence I-state) and Sec. V-A Fig. 7(a) (bipartite I-state), pp. 2334-2335
notes: Same shadow sequence as T-RO Fig. 11(b) (tests/fixtures/tor_fig11.json) except that the children of s1 are named the other way round: ICRA08 has split 1->7,6, split 6->9,8 and merge 2+7->15, T-RO has split 1->6,7, split 7->9,8 and merge 2+6->15. The bipartite graph (Fig. 7(a)) is identical to T-RO Fig. 11(c). ICRA08 gives no numeric bounds; the T-RO Sec. V-C numbers are reused (1:(2,4) 2:(0,3) 3:(5,5) 4:(2,6) 5:(4,5) 9:(2,3) 10:(1,3) 12:(3,8) 14:(2,4) 18:(5,7)), so s19 must again be [10,24]. ICRA08 Fig. 4 labels the box under s9 'v14' (typo for v9).
